env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: drives nmap / DNS / HTTP / fingerprinting; every finding traces to real tool output
env_context_strategy.note: Tool-backed ReAct loop drives recon tools; agent explores the target.

observation_format.evidence_quote: every finding traces to real tool output
observation_format.note: Tool output (nmap/HTTP/etc.) surfaced as text; no other modality described.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Tool-calling works on any local model (it's driven over text), so the Arsenal runs even on models without native function-calling.
tool_call_format.note: Native function-calling for capable models (e.g. Grok Build), text-driven fallback otherwise.

tool_count.evidence_quote: 36 built-in tools by default; 109 with the opt-in `T3MP3ST_FULL_ARSENAL`

edit_primitive.note: Offensive-security harness; no file-edit primitive described in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: MCP server exposes tools; built-in adapters presumably hand-authored (not shown in source).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the kill chain runs itself: **recon → exploit → report**
loop_primitives.note: Each operator runs a 'real tool-backed ReAct loop'; the kill chain is a staged pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: describe a target to **Op Admiral** in plain English and launch
planning_granularity.note: Mission phases follow the kill chain; no stored plan object evidenced.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: AGENT CELL: RECON · SCANNER · EXPLOITER · INFILTRATOR · EXFILTRATOR · GHOST · COORDINATOR · ANALYST

delegation_mechanism.note: Distinct operator agents coordinated; exact hand-off mechanism not shown in evidence.

human_in_loop.note: Disclosure pipeline produces drafts; a human reviews/sends. Updater also asks y/N but that is not agent-action gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: EVIDENCE VAULT · CREDENTIAL STORE · FINDINGS LEDGER

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: records lessons + proposals today; feeding them back into planning is roadmap

self_verification.evidence_quote: OSV novelty + live PoC + refuter panel + CVSS
self_verification.note: Live PoC execution verifies findings; refuter panel judges them.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the kill chain runs itself: **recon → exploit → report**

cost_controls.note: Provider/model selection exists but no cost- or content-based routing evidenced.

timeouts.evidence_quote: `T3MP3ST_LOCAL_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS` for each CLI call, `T3MP3ST_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS` for mission tasks

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: driven by the agent you're *already* signed into

filesystem_access.note: Runs on the operator host with host tool access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: once a mission target is set, built-in networked tools refuse off-scope public hosts
network_policy.note: Egress-scope containment on by default; target/subdomains allowed.

permission_model.evidence_quote: behind narrow approved paths rather than generic execution
permission_model.note: Scope allowlist for egress plus gated dangerous drivers (metasploit, hydra, pacu, frida).

tracing.evidence_quote: every headline recomputes from committed artifacts

replayability.evidence_quote: Raw per-step transcripts are stripped for operator privacy, so you re-check the **graded verdict**, not the raw tool output.
replayability.note: verify-claims recomputes graded verdicts, not a re-run of the trajectory.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `npm run verify-claims` re-derives all of them, 27/27 green
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark suites (XBEN, Cybench, CVE-Zero, cloud:bench, mobile:bench, binary:bench) ship in the repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: once a mission target is set, built-in networked tools refuse off-scope public hosts
guardrails.note: Scope-denial and gated dangerous drivers validate actions before execution.
